issue_ledger.exact_failure: Frozen scripts/check_lane_liveness.py maps GitHub commit.committer.date to created_at_utc and treats a receipt as on-time whenever that value is at/before the frozen deadline. GitHub's raw Git Create a commit API permits the caller to supply author/committer date. The monitor records committer_login but does not source-bind the timestamp or prove a server-generated creation event. Therefore a post-deadline receipt can have an apparently pre-deadline commit timestamp under a sufficiently capable writer, undermining immutable creation-time liveness authority.
issue_ledger.next_action: MM06/BIL00 independently rerun this falsifier. If confirmed, Gen10 receives zero clean-cohort credit and the liveness authority is repaired prospectively in a new immutable protocol-2.5 generation at streak zero.
issue_ledger.proposed_protocol_2_5_fix_test: Use a server-generated, expected-source and exact-head-bound timestamp witness for after-deadline adjudication, or a trusted monitor receipt persisted before deadline. Treat Git author/committer timestamps as informational only.
issue_ledger.required_test: Create a report commit first observed after deadline with committer date backdated before deadline and no trusted server-time witness; admission MUST be RUN_TIMING_UNKNOWN or RUN_LATE with transition_liveness_pass=false. Pair with before-deadline and expected-source server-time positive controls.
issue_ledger.summary: After-deadline receipt timing trusts a Git commit committer timestamp that is not intrinsically server-generated.
